intro: In Stormwind, Renato Gallina hands out Wine Tickets to bring customers to his family's shop. Present one to Suzetta Gallina for a complimentary bottle of Pinot Noir.

p: Renato Gallina promotes the Gallina Winery with printed tickets near Stormwind's Trade District. The winery is a boutique vintage shop along the nearby canals. Each ticket promises a complimentary sample of Pinot Noir, drawing curious passersby and newly arrived adventurers toward the family business in hopes they become loyal customers.
